title: Source-based example — Weathering of rocks
source_example: Temperature changes due to climatic conditions, growing roots of trees, and even freezing of water within cracks in the rocks can cause them to break.
explanation: How have these formed? These are formed by physical changes that break up large rocks into smaller pieces.

title: Source-based example — Erosion
source_example: River rocks and pebbles often appear smoother due to the constant erosion caused by the fl owing water.
explanation: Erosion during a landslide is an example of a physical change.
